title: Sokosumi free DESIGN.md generator from any website URL
summary: Sokosumi free tool at sokosumi.com/tools/design-md opens a remote browser on any URL, reads computed styles, and writes a Google DESIGN.md spec for colors, type, spacing, and components. Edit, copy, or download for Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
question_it_answers: What is the free URL-to-DESIGN.md extractor in the Sokosumi toolchain?

claims.text: Tool reads computed styles via remote browser and outputs Google DESIGN.md format.
claims.evidence: Remote browser opens the page, reads computed styles, writes structured DESIGN.md.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Shortcuts include Stripe, Linear, Vercel, and Notion example URLs.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Unauthed POST /api/design-md queued example.com and returned a 12,675-byte LLM DESIGN.md in 43.6 s (extractionId 1940, source=llm). Hyperbrowser POST /api/generate still 401 API key required.
claims.evidence: job d00a14fe-213e-4152-a92f-c05e3cb1ec49 done; surface #eeeeee primary #334488. Hyperbrowser {"error":"API key required"}. See sokosumi-design-md NOTES.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Sokosumi gallery lists 1,211 llm extracts. Published Linear/Stripe/Notion YAML have 47 color keys each. Linear surface #08090a matches Refero Void, but Linear primary #e5e5e6 does not match Refero Acid Lime #e4f222; Notion #0075de and Stripe #533afd do match Refero.
claims.evidence: GET /api/design-md/gallery total 1211. Analysis pages + cached POST linear.app 1872 / stripe.com 1755. Refero NOTES for the JSON side.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills
